source_inventory.duplicate_nl_note: 10 unique Requirement Description entries; each has six generated PlantUML outputs from Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, GPT-4o, Kimi and Llama.
source_inventory.leakage_note: Only Generation PlantUML is STM_0; reference PlantUML and Result with Format/Grammar/Semantic Checking are excluded.

data_construction.paper_claim_summary: 论文描述 curated dataset 含 SysML behavior models、PlantUML 与 natural-language requirements；实验用 LLM 根据 requirement description 生成 PlantUML，并另有 format / grammar / semantic checking 后处理。
data_construction.artifact_source: 论文 Google Drive folder，通过 gdown 下载 Experiment Results.xlsx、Dataset.xlsx 与 Drive README。
data_construction.generation_or_construction_pipeline: Requirement Description -> prompt / LLM -> Generation PlantUML；reference PlantUML 与 checking 后结果只作评价或泄漏风险说明。
data_construction.what_is_raw_nl: STM Results sheet 的 Requirement Description 列。
data_construction.what_is_stm0: STM Results sheet 的 Generation PlantUML 列，代表 LLM 初始生成状态机。

quality_audit.quality_findings: 抽检行均可由 workbook sheet/row/column 回溯；Requirement Description 与 Generation PlantUML 可对齐，reference PlantUML 与 generated output 不混用。
quality_audit.domain_fit_caveat: SysML 行为模型需求高度相关，但同一 workbook 含 reference / checking columns，必须白名单字段防泄漏。

pair_sets.generation_model_or_method: LLM prompt results in Experiment Results.xlsx / STM Results sheet
pair_sets.stm_family: SysML/UML state machine expressed in PlantUML
pair_sets.eligibility_note: 可直接作为一手 Phase-I LLM-generated PlantUML seed 使用；同一 workbook 含 reference/checking 后结果，使用时必须列白名单只读 Requirement Description 与 Generation PlantUML。 R5.5 cluster-level profile supersedes the earlier coarse T0 assumption: 8 clusters are T0, Microwave is T0.5 timer-like caveat, and Digital Camera is T1 supplementary stress.

stm0_source_fields: last non-empty Result with Semantic/Grammar/Format Checking

resource_profile.resource_profile_notes: 一手 workbook 已含 generated PlantUML，无需复跑。模型可用性按 2026-06-23 官方/模型页核验：GPT-4/GPT-4o 仍有 OpenAI 官方模型页；OpenAI deprecations 列出部分旧/legacy shutdown；Claude 3 Haiku 已退役；Moonshot/Kimi V1 在 Kimi 模型页需按当前线上模型替代；Llama 3.1 与 DeepSeek-V3 仍可在 Hugging Face 模型页定位。
